map.月薪 1 万多类加班: Several types of overtime on a ¥10,000 monthly salary
map.日工资 = 10000 ÷ 21.75 ≈ 459.77 元，时薪 ≈ 57.4: Daily wage = 10000 ÷ 21.75 ≈ ¥459.77, hourly wage ≈ ¥57.47. Weekday overtime of 10 hours ≈ ¥862; one rest day at 200% ≈ ¥920; one public holiday at 300% ≈ ¥1,379; about ¥3,161 in all.
map.休息日加班 2 天且未补休：459.77 × 2 × 2 = 1839 元。: Two rest days with no compensatory rest: 459.77 × 2 × 2 = ¥1,839.
map.法定月计薪天数 =（365 − 104 休息日）÷ 12 = 21.75 天，用: The statutory paid days per month = (365 − 104 rest days) ÷ 12 = 21.75 days, used to convert a monthly wage into a daily or hourly wage.
map.法定节假日加班能用补休代替吗？: Can compensatory rest replace public holiday overtime pay?
map.不能，法定节假日安排工作的应支付不低于工资 300% 的报酬，不得以补休替代；休: No. Work on a public holiday must be paid at not less than 300% of the wage and cannot be replaced by rest; for rest day work, compensatory rest may be given first.
